units.source_text: 过了几日，惟光大夫来参谒了。

en.t: A few days later, Koremitsu no Taifu came to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 他说：“老母病体始终未见好转，奔走求医，

en.t: He said, "My old mother's illness has shown no sign of improving, and I have been running about seeking doctors,

units.source_text: 至今始能抽身前来，甚是失礼。”

en.t: so only now have I been able to get away and come here. I have been most discourteous."

units.source_text: 谢罪之后，来到公子身边，悄悄地报道：“前日受命之后，

en.t: After apologizing, he came to the young lord's side and quietly reported, "After receiving your instructions the other day,

units.source_text: 我就教家人找个熟悉邻家情况的人，向他探问。

en.t: I had my people find someone familiar with the neighboring household and questioned him.

units.source_text: 然而那人知道的也不很详细，只说‘五月间有一女子秘密到此，

en.t: But even that person knew very little in detail; he only said, 'Around the fifth month, a woman came here secretly,

units.source_text: 其人身份如何，连家里的人也不让知道。’

en.t: and even the people of the house were not allowed to know what her status was.'

units.source_text: 我自己有时也向壁缝中窥探，看到几个侍女模样的年轻人。

en.t: I myself have sometimes peered through cracks in the wall and seen several young women who looked like attendants.

units.source_text: 她们都穿着罩裙，足见这屋子里有主人住着，

en.t: They were all wearing over-skirts, which clearly shows that a mistress lives in that house,

units.source_text: 要她们伺候的。

en.t: and that she has them serving her.

units.source_text: 昨天下午，夕阳照进这屋子里，光线很亮，

en.t: Yesterday afternoon, the setting sun shone into the house and the light was very bright,

units.source_text: 我窥探一下，看见一个女人坐着写信，相貌实在漂亮！

en.t: so I took a look and saw a woman sitting there writing a letter; she was truly beautiful!

units.source_text: 她似乎在沉思。

en.t: She seemed to be sunk in thought.

units.source_text: 旁边的侍女似乎在偷偷地哭泣，我看得很清楚呢。”

en.t: The attendant beside her seemed to be weeping secretly; I saw it quite clearly."

units.source_text: 源氏公子微微一笑，想道：“打听得更详细点才好。”

en.t: Prince Genji smiled faintly and thought, "It would be better to find out more details."

units.source_text: 惟光心中想：“我的主子身份高贵，地位尊严，

en.t: Koremitsu thought to himself, "My lord is of noble birth and exalted rank,

units.source_text: 然而年方青春，容姿俊秀，天下女子，莫不风靡。

en.t: yet he is in the bloom of youth, handsome in appearance, and there is no woman in the world who would not be captivated by him.

units.source_text: 倘无色情之事，未免缺少风流，美中不足吧。

en.t: If there were no affairs of love, he would surely lack romance, and that would be a flaw in his perfection.

units.source_text: 世间愚夫俗子、藐不足数的人，看见了这等美人尚且舍不得呢。”

en.t: Even foolish, common, insignificant men in the world would be unable to let such a beauty pass them by."

units.source_text: 他又告诉公子：“我想或许可以多探得些消息，

en.t: He also told the young lord, "I thought I might be able to learn a little more,

units.source_text: 所以有一次找个机会，送一封信去，

en.t: so on one occasion I found an opportunity and sent in a letter.

units.source_text: 立刻就有人用熟练的笔致写了一封回信给我。

en.t: Someone immediately wrote me a reply in a practiced hand.

units.source_text: 看来里面确有很不错的青年美女呢。”

en.t: It seems there truly is a rather fine young beauty inside."

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“那么，你再去求爱吧。

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Then you should go court her again.

units.source_text: 不知道个底细，总觉得不安心。”

en.t: Not knowing the truth of the matter somehow leaves me uneasy."

units.source_text: 他心中想：“这夕颜花之家，大约就是那天雨夜品评中所谓下等的下等，

en.t: He thought to himself, "This house of evening faces is probably what was called the lowest of the low in that rainy-night discussion,

units.source_text: 是左马头所认为不足道的吧。

en.t: the sort that the Captain of the Left Division of Horses considered beneath notice.

units.source_text: 然而其中也许可以意外地看到优越的女子。”

en.t: Yet within it, one might unexpectedly find an excellent woman."

units.source_text: 他觉得这倒是稀世珍闻呢。

en.t: He felt that this was, in fact, a rare and curious discovery.
